statement: The labels in fixtures/phase15/eval-labels.json and the application fixtures/phase15/eval-app were written before any Phase 15 scoring and before any CommitRift command was run on this application (no cargo build and no commitrift invocation of any kind was made by the author; scripts/phase15-eval.py was written but not run). They were written by an AI author (Claude), from PostgreSQL (READ COMMITTED unless a case says otherwise) and JavaScript semantics, without reading crates/, runtime/, docs/phase14/ or docs/phase15/. The author read fixtures/phase14/EVALUATION-DATASET.md, fixtures/phase14/eval-labels.json, fixtures/phase14/eval-app, fixtures/phase13/eval-labels.json, scripts/phase14-eval.py and docs/reference, docs/concepts and docs/user-guide; it therefore knew the documented supported subset and its documented gaps (including the Phase 14 notes that synthesis may make an initial value coincide with the written value and does not explore null arguments), so this set is fresh but not blind. The application was type-checked in a scratch copy outside the repository against the drizzle-orm 0.45.4 and pg 8.23.1 typings (TypeScript 5.6, strict), and the SQL of label-critical statements was printed with Drizzle's toSQL() on a mock driver in that copy (no database, no CommitRift); neither artifact is part of the fixture. No independent human review performed. Any label later found wrong is recorded in eval-labels.json `corrections` with a reason, never by editing a label.
manifest: sha256 of the UTF-8 text made of one line '<sha256>  <path>\n' (two spaces, LF) for every file above, sorted by path in byte order (LC_ALL=C sort; equal to Python's sorted()): exactly the output of `cd fixtures/phase15 && (find eval-app -type f; echo eval-labels.json) | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum -a 256`, hashed with `shasum -a 256`. scripts/phase15-eval.py recomputes it from `files` the same way.
